boards: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game sprite atlas for a Unity illustrated physics timber platform. The attached game screenshot is STYLE reference, especially its broad honey-brown wooden suspended plank under the S N U tiles. Create ONE 4-by-4 atlas (4 equal columns x 4 equal rows), 1536x1024 landscape. Each cell contains the SAME straight horizontal broad plank, FRONT slightly above eye-level perspective, with a narrow load-bearing top bevel, rounded worn end caps and small iron studs near the ends. No knots, rope, leaves, icons, numbers or labels. Transparent spacing around every plank. Board spans 90% of each cell width, depth about 30% of cell height, perfectly same position/geometry in all 16 cells. Four columns: (1) warm honey timber, (2) same timber frame with a cool silver mirror inset running lengthwise down its center, (3) same timber with polished turquoise blue roller strips and inset brass bearings, (4) same timber with a light sky blue polished wind inset. Four rows: pristine, mildly worn with one small hairline fissure, severely worn with cracked grain and small chips, broken middle split with two aligned jagged half planks and scattered fibers staying inside the same cell. All damage states must retain unchanged end anchors and geometric envelope so a flexible mesh can bend naturally. Saturated warm painterly 3D fairy-tale game material, realistic wood grain and soft relief, consistent top-left lighting. Clean actual alpha transparency, no glow/backdrop/shadow rectangle. Matching the screenshot material exactly, not photoreal rough industrial wood. No grids, titles, text, watermark.
rope: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE clean transparent vertical hemp rope material for a Unity game LineRenderer. Style reference is the braided golden rope of the attached illustrated fairy-tale game. Generate a straight vertical rope centered in a 256x1024 canvas, occupying about 65% width, thick clean three-strand braid, warm honey golden flax fibers with clearly readable interlocking diagonal strands, subtle lighter front ridge and brown side shading. Uniform consistent thickness, exactly parallel and straight, NO knot, no frayed ends, no hardware or attachments. Continue the braid seamlessly at top and bottom so it can be tiled along a rope with physical motion. Photographic detail softened into high quality illustrated 3D game asset, bright saturated honey colors. Actual transparent alpha beyond both side silhouettes. No cast shadow/background/rectangle. No text.
frame: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single tall transparent framing sprite for the gameplay scene, 720:1280 portrait composition. Match the warm illustrated 3D adventure game style of the attached screenshot. Make ONLY slender natural warm wooden side trunks and curved corner branches, narrow bottom stone/wood ledge with clean center, restrained sparse green foliage limited to the four corners and a few tiny leaves on the outer edges. NO FLOWERS AT ALL, NO DAISIES, no lanterns, birds, islands or houses baked into it, no ropes, buttons, words or UI. The middle 86% of the image is entirely transparent and empty, full transparent sky opening. Keep side frames under 7% of total width; top has very thin connecting timber under 5% height, bottom under 8% height. Do not put a large arch ornament. Warm honey wood, lush but modest leaves, high saturation, natural perspective ledge, clean silhouettes and genuine alpha transparency. Entire sprite fits inside the canvas, no clipping of outer leaves. Source screenshot is style/context only; remove its UI and scene entirely.
failure_mika: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent character sprite for the game failure result screen. The attached reference is the required character pose and identity. Generate ONLY Mika the cute warm ginger mouse with big rounded ears, long fluffy curled tail, cream shirt, olive-green patched overalls, mustard-yellow scarf, leather shoulder bag. Match the fourth attached screenshot exactly: sitting sadly on a narrow imaginary hanging bench, BOTH palms supporting his cheeks, elbows on his knees, head bowed, friendly big worried eyes looking down, boots dangling forward. Full body including entire tail, both boots and bag visible. Copy the reference silhouette, proportions, saturated colors and soft illustrated 3D lighting. No lantern, apple, bench, wood board, rope, background or glow. His feet rest at the bottom center, isolated genuine transparent alpha with clean fur edges. High quality, no rectangular haze. No text or additional items.
receiver: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated game UI hanging target tray sprite, transparent background, wide landscape 4:1. Copy the LOWER pale hanging wooden tray from the attached game screenshot, below the words "Собери этот ряд". A creamy ivory softly grained inset surrounded by a rich honey-brown rounded wooden frame, gold/brass rope eyelets at left and right side centered vertically, warm bevels, thick rounded corners, perspective depth on the underside. Center is completely empty pale cream with NO tile slots or tiles, letters, numbers, words. No rope, greenery, leaves, flowers or background. All details and corners fit inside the canvas with transparent margin. Highly saturated illustrated 3D fairy-tale game style, soft front-left lighting. Exact shape from reference, ready for nine-slicing: uniform empty inset, 85% of width empty, ornate end caps restricted to outer 7% each. No big decorative scrolls. Clean genuine alpha edge.
